# apple_app_search_keywords (Data Source)

Lists the search keywords App Store Connect offers for an app, for `apple_app_store_version_localization_search_keyword`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_search_keywords" "en_us" {
  app_id   = data.apple_app.example.id
  platform = "IOS"
  locale   = "en-US"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `locale` (String) Only keywords for this locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `platform` (String) Only keywords for this platform: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the keywords.
